flags.message: The State's brief in opposition (docketed Jun 2, 2026, 'Brief of respondent Washington filed') and the petitioner's reply (Jun 10, 2026) were not provisioned under record/documents/ although both were on the docket at snapshot time; documents.json lists only the petition and QP. I fetched both from supremecourt.gov and read them; the BIO's GVR request is central to the forecast.

Decisive forward signal from public information predating the snapshot: Louisiana v. Callais (decided Apr 29, 2026) and the companion petition Trevino v. Hobbs, No. 25-918 (same counsel, same conference), in which the State of Washington asks for a GVR in light of Callais and asks for the same disposition here. No information about this petition's own disposition was found; the case is pending.
